thread:
nina: noticed repeated short NIC microbursts on a few dedicated slices in us-west-2 this morning. p99 token latency spikes and allocator churn.

sam: what size/duration? quick numbers help.

nina: 150-600ms, ~30-90MB each. not sustained. scheduler reacts and moves workloads.

raj: sounds like noisy-neighbor egress. Host-edge shaping might prevent allocator moves.

nina: proposal: implement host-side token-bucket with small escrow + cluster fallback. allow microbursts but throttle cascades.

sam: paste config sketch?

nina: ```
host_proxy:
  tenant_egress:
    policy: token_bucket
    steady_rate_mb_s: 80
    burst_mb: 48
    escrow_window_ms: 3000
    overflow: cluster_fallback
```

raj: metrics needed: escrow_exhausted, host_overflow, fallback_routed, allocator_moves_delta.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: enable host pacing on rack-rw3 for 48h. will post rollout logs.

sam: runbook note: exclude deploy traffic and set budget header so billing knows fallback costs.

nina: I'll open a PR for host proxy changes and add unit tests simulating bursts. raj -> telemetry dashboard. sam -> runbook + budget header. sync 09:00 PT tomorrow.

sam: LGTM. go ahead. :thumbsup:
file_comment: short canary thread proposing host-edge tenant egress token-bucket to reduce noisy neighbor-induced allocator churn
